responsibility: Implements the public C vector intrinsic interface for System z’s vector extension, defining classification constants, convenience macros, lightweight inline helpers such as __lcbb, and a large mapping layer from Altivec-style vec_* APIs to S/390 builtins. It is the user-facing intrinsic header that exposes vector facility operations, comparisons, conversions, masking, string/search helpers, and floating-point class tests on top of GCC’s S/390 builtin set.
